submitted_sql: SELECT track_id, SUM(quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2009-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-01-01') GROUP BY track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 1;
